behavior: A first actual MCP callback binds before the delayed provider creation receipt. Matching send retry returns one receipt and produces one message through the public native client.

A saved dispatch intent precedes one SDK POST. A lost/failed response preserves the nonce, credential, task, lifetime and issuance identity. An independently verified callback reconciles the original resource without a second POST.

Current setup authority is checked before private lookup and again after it. Four explicitly paused cases deny callback issuance or recovered-resource return after cancellation or parent revocation; denied Store snapshots do not change.

Nine malformed/duplicate/foreign header cases deny before any private GET or task mutation. Invalid setup configurations, scope escalation, overwrite and revoked parent preparation deny without new state.
Wrong nonce, inactive/unavailable resource, a conflicting resource with matching metadata and revoked original grant cannot establish new authority. Grant replay never remints a revoked grant.
Two concurrent tasks in one installation use separate setup credentials and distinct verified resources. A foreign setup credential cannot authenticate the other endpoint.
Session creation appends the MCP tool and retains the saved assistant's other tool configuration. The private response metadata must independently carry the exact UUID creation nonce.
